description: This file contains utility functions for mobile model optimization and linting in PyTorch, including methods to optimize script modules for mobile deployment and generate lints based on module properties.

classes.name: LintCode
classes.description: Enumeration for different lint types related to mobile model optimization.

methods.name: optimize_for_mobile
methods.description: Optimizes a Torch script module for mobile deployment, supporting different backends and preserving specified methods.

methods.name: generate_mobile_module_lints
methods.description: Generates a list of lints for a given Torch script module, identifying issues like missing bundled inputs or parameters requiring gradients.

methods.name: _get_bundled_inputs_preserved_attributes
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve attributes related to bundled inputs that should be preserved during optimization.
